competitors.name: Creatopy
competitors.summary: A design-and-production platform for ads: an ad studio with templates, AI generation, resizing and publishing to ad networks.
facts: Pro plan listed at $39 a month billed monthly, for one seat; includes an Ad Studio and Canvas with 5,000+ templates and 5 Brand Kits.
Ultra plan listed at $99 a month billed monthly; adds ad serving to 25+ networks, publishing to Meta and Google Ads, AI translate and automated A/B testing.
Team plan listed at $59 per seat a month billed monthly, for 2 to 10 people.
Paid plans show a 7-day free trial with no card required.

competitors.name: Madgicx
competitors.summary: A Meta-ads optimisation and analytics platform with AI features, priced by your monthly ad spend.
facts: Madgicx Pro Complete is priced by monthly ad spend: from $45 a month (spend under $1K, billed monthly) to $99 a month ($1K to $2.5K); higher tiers go up to $329 a month for $20K to $30K spend, and above $30K the price is shown inside the app.
Quarterly and annual billing lower the monthly price shown.
Tracking Pro, a server-to-server tracking add-on, is listed at $49 a month.

competitors.name: Predis.ai
competitors.summary: An AI tool for social posts, video and ad creatives, with scheduling and publishing, sold on credits.
facts: Advertises making ads, videos and UGC "for less than $1/day" and a 3-day free trial; you are not charged until the trial ends.
Plans are credit-based; one higher plan lists 10,000 credits a month, described as about 2,500 images or 250 videos.
Can publish to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Google Business Profile and X.
Its pricing page showed a Black Friday offer of 50% off annual plans on the verified date; promotions end, so check the page.

competitors.name: AdCreative.ai
competitors.summary: An AI ad-creative platform covering image ads, video ads, ad copy, A/B testing and creative insights.
facts: Lists generating ad creatives, ad copy, UGC-style and product videos, social posts and buyer personas.
Lists creative insights and competitor insights, and offers a "Try For Free" call to action.
States it has been used by 4.2M+ businesses and is trained on $35B+ of ad spend data (the vendor's own claims, not verified by us).
Its home page did not show plan prices when we checked; see the vendor's site for current pricing.
